newsitem.title: USA: Ecogen gets market OK for Lepinox pesticide.
newsitem.headline: Ecogen gets market OK for Lepinox pesticide.

text.p: Ecogen Inc, which develops and markets specialty biopesticides products, said on Thursday it received approval from the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency to market Lepinox bioinsecticide, for control of fall armyworm.
Ecogen said it would initially target application of Lepinox on sweetcorn, a $15 million market in Florida.
Fall armyworm is also a pest in turf, pastures and Southern row crops, it said.

Lepinox is designed to work as a standalone product or as part of an integrated pest management program, the company said. Ecogen said it plans to make Lepinox available this spring to growers for control of fall armyworm, with an aggressive full-scale market launch set for autumn 1997.
